back: A natural liking for or identification with someone or something (e.g., 'a close affinity between Singapore and Hong Kong') [1].

Very different and not related to each other (e.g., 'disparate tribes') [1, 2].
Independent of other things; separate (e.g., 'discrete categories') [1, 2].
Different from each other or from a standard (e.g., 'divergent viewpoints') [1].

Including many different types of people or things (e.g., 'a diverse selection of music') [1].
Not the same as something else [1].

Clearly different or belonging to a different type [1].
